answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same grove anchor, so spawning sybils requires acquiring fresh hardware and stake, making each fake identity cost real capital. Each agent must stake a unique marble token bound to a hardware grove signature, verified once per epoch. A rotating zephyr challenge then randomly samples agents for proof-of-liveness, and failure slashes stake. Attacker costs scale linearly with fake identities, deterring mass sybil creation. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
